Four killed in Poonch LoC blast, identities disputed

Four people were killed in an IED or landmine blast on the Line of Control in Poonch district of Jammu & Kashmir; the explosion killed four individuals from the Pakistan‑occupied side and security was heightened afterwards, while reports differ on how the victims are identified, with some describing them as residents, others as suspected infiltrators or terrorists, and one report noting a senior Lashkar‑e‑Taiba commander among them.
